title: Inter(sectional) Alia(s): Ambiguity in Voice Agent Identity via Intersectional Japanese Self-Referents

bias_targets.methodology: Within-subjects online user perception study asking participants to categorize the gender of ChatGPT voices paired with various Japanese self-referents to measure gender stereotyping, neutrality, and ambiguity.
Analyzing participant ratings of the perceived age of the AI agent (ranging from baby to older adult) based on different voice and self-referent combinations.
Thematic analysis of open-ended user responses to evaluate whether specific pronoun-voice combinations elicited rural or dialect-based stereotypes.
Examining open-ended qualitative responses for stereotypic associations with sexual minorities (e.g., 'gay' or 'onee' language) triggered by gender-mismatched voice and pronoun combinations.
